description: Simplus Grid Tool (SimplusGT) is an open-source tool for dynamic analysis and time-domain simulation of power systems built on MATLAB and Simulink, listed on the G-PST Open Tools Portal with Imperial College London as developer. The README (version dated 20 September 2026) says it handles large systems of 100 or more buses, systems mixing synchronous generators and inverter-based resources, and AC, DC, hybrid AC-DC and HVDC systems. It needs MATLAB 2020a or later with Simulink and Simscape Power Systems; after running the installer script, a main script produces results for an example 4-bus system whose parameters sit in an Excel workbook, with more examples and manuals in the repository. Coverage: user-built transmission and distribution systems. Format and access: MATLAB source on GitHub (Future-Power-Networks/Simplus-Grid-Tool); contacts are at Xi'an Jiaotong University and Imperial College London. Licence: BSD 3-Clause (portal); no LICENSE file was found at the repository root. Caveats: needs commercial MATLAB and Simulink licences; the manuals were not read. Simulation uses: small-signal stability and electromagnetic transient studies of grids with high shares of inverter-based generation. Related records: MATPOWER (model-matpower), also MATLAB-based, covers steady-state power flow.
